title: Mosquito Tone (15 kHz)
blurb: A pure 15 kHz tone — the infamous mosquito tone that most teenagers can hear and most adults cannot. It's a hearing test, a science demo, and a legendary classroom prank rolled into one button. Play it in mixed company and map exactly who still has their high-frequency hearing, based on who winces. Two seconds long, synthesized clean. Use at reasonable volume — it's sharp.
origin: Pure 15 kHz sine tone — audibility drops sharply with age, hence the name.
